notes.title: Demo Patch 0.2.0 - New Lunar Knights
notes.notes:
Greetings Lunar Knights!

A new patch has come for the Bloodmoon Survivors Demo. I've added 3 Lunar Knights to the roster with their own distinct play styles and reworked the gameplay systems to support them as individual combatants.  This includes a new powerup tree to replace some that I've shuffled around and a couple tweaks to their combat abilities.

I hope you enjoy!


Patch Notes

Characters
Created 3 unique playable characters for the demo (6 in full game) with unique perfect-weapon-switch abilities that give them escape and maneuverability options timed with their weapon swaps

Added a recharge system for character weapon swap abilities

Added unique character weapon trick times so that each on feels unique

Removed Bully tree powerups: Long arm and Strong Arm powerups have been reworked to act as the starting character's ability

Added new Powerup Tree Vampirism which permanently increases damage of the weapon you kill enemies with

Created mastery achievements to upgrade characters and improve their weapon swap abilities

Added 21 new Achievements related to characters and their masteries

UI: Added a character select page to the start menu

UI: Added a character unlock tab to the blessings menu
Tutorial
Added an explanation on how to trigger new character abilities

Updated Movement and Aiming explanations with the correct Glyphs to accurately show how it is accomplished

Shortened the tutorial's powerup explanations
Tweaks/Improvements
Reduced move speed of flaming skeleton ghosts in level 1 from 1000 > 900

Fixed a bug with the bullet spawn of projectiles being too far away from the player character.  This was causing a dead zone where enemies could stand between the player and his firearm where enemies could not get hit

I fixed a bug where when abandoning a run, the player could still take damage until the main menu screen loaded

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:
Additions
Added a Credits menu to the main menu to list everyone involved in the project

Made it so boss chest upgrades can be rerolled.  This shares the same count as rerolling powerups.

Added a new moon shard variant that increases the player’s Upgrade or Rerolls by +1
Tweaks/Improvements
Changed the “Difficulty” option menu title to “Accessibility”

Listed all 5 braveries when selecting difficulty and gave the locked ones a “Locked” icon so it’s easy to distinguish that there are more to get but they are not currently available

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes:
Patch Notes
Fixed a bug where players were unlocking the wrong weapon on level 2 for beating the corresponding boss

Updated the Weapon Select screen to specify which achievement is required to unlock a weapon. Furthermore if the weapon achievement is completed, it directs you to the blessings menu to purchase the weapon

notes.title: Massive Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Greetings Lunar Knights!



A new patch has come for the Bloodmoon Survivors Demo.  This is a large rework of the progression systems in the game and a change to the economy of the game.

I hope you enjoy!


Patch NotesData Wipe
First and foremost, I apologize but this patch requires a reset to save data.  The changes to the game were so big that I needed to wipe existing data.  I apologize for the inconvenience.  
Economy Rebalance
All upgrades will be available for purchase in the Demo

Added new currencies “Elite Souls” and “Boss Souls” which are gained from killing elites and bosses

Rebalanced upgrade, weapon unlocks, powerup ability unlocks around new currencies

Made it easier to unlock upgrades
Health System
Reworked health system where hearts are divisible. Player can now take percentile damage to hearts instead of just 1 heart of damage with each hit

Added an new upgrade that blocks (reduces damage) so enemies deal reduced damage

Changed armor to block one full HIT of damage, no matter how much damage it is

Removed heal on last heart regen logic and replaced with a passive regeneration rate which is upgradable
New Upgrades
Added upgrade to increase player block. Reducing enemy damage when receiving it

Added new upgrade for collecting more gold

Health regen is now a passive effect that is always active no matter how many heart points the player has

Created new upgrade that reduces the max kills required to trigger dual wield

Added new upgrades to deal more damage to resistant enemies and boss enemies

Added new upgrade that lets player increase the RARITY TIER of a current upgrade without rerolling the upgrade itself (Look out for legendary rolls, they're upgradable too now ^.^)

Made icons for new upgrades! 
Drop rates
There was a bug making chests and barrels drop WAYYYY more gold than the economy demanded.  I reduced spawn rates.  

Increased gold drop rates based on the difficulty of the level you are playing

Increased drop rates of healing items

Reduced drop rate of armor
Boss Chest Powerup Balancing
Swift Metal: armor gain from 2 > 1

Wind Up Chop: Reduced melee size increase from 40% > 30%

Status effect powerups: Increase from 40% > 50%
Weapon Rebalancing
Projectile weapons were too weak, so I gave all projectile weapons at least 1 pierce or bounce so they can hit multiple targets right away

Crossbow Pierce increase 0 > 1

Scattershot Pierce: 0 > 1

Increased War Bow Attack Speed
General Balancing
Bumped the kills required to trigger dual wield from 150 to 200 (This can now be reduced through upgrades)
Enemy Balancing
Reduced projectile speed of level 1 mage enemies projectiles

Runner enemies now phase through all other enemies

Fixed boss and elite movement by setting to extremely heavy weight so other enemies can't push them toward the player

Fixed Resistance enemies by setting to heavy weight so they don’t get pushed around by other enemies

Fixed Resistance enemies by giving them distinct OUTLINES based on their resistances 

Added new enemy spawn patterns such as rings and and mobs to swarm the player

First major boss (rock golem) was resisting projectile damage too aggressively (setting it to 0) made it a lower reduction so you can still damage him with projectile attacks
General Bug Fixes
Fixed a bug where if you quit the game while the tutorial was playing you would skip it entirely the next time you play a round.  Now, you must complete the whole tutorial in order to have it marked as completed.

Fixed a bug where triggering a level up after completing the level (which happened when exp resources are automatically pulled in on level completed) caused the subsequent round for the player to not be able to level up.

The square spawn area puts enemies coming from the top and bottoms of the screen too far away (specifically bosses) so I reduced their spawn distance from player from 60 to 50 on the y-vector

Fixed bug where achievement for healing 5 times was counting health regen and tutorial healing

Added hit-flash to ore resource veins and quest chests so it's obvious when you attack them

Fixed a bug where if the player won the round, the auto attack would remain enabled and they would continue attacking during the win-screen

Fixed wording on double boss shrine to more clearly state you will face 2 bosses instead of 1 the next time you fight a boss

Fixed a bug where if a boss is on screen and you die, the "death clean up" logic will kill the boss for you and unlock achievements

Fixed a bug where the player can get pushed around by enemies

Disabled outlines accessibility option to not conflict with new resistance enemy outline highlights

Fixed a bug where picking up the soldier horn item wasn’t spawning the corresponding reward

Fixed a bug where armor was not appearing correctly when the game started. If you unlocked extra armor in the beginning it was not visible on the gameplay HUD until taking damage

Fixed a bug where follow up quests in a quest chain were not spawning until a specified time (They should immediately trigger after the previous quest is completed)

Increased the amount of dual wield meter charge bosses drop (since they don’t have other enemies around them)
Powerup Balancing
Armorer Powerup: Armor gain only triggers if you are at 3 armor or less

Live Triage Powerup: Decreased heal to half a heart

Heartiness Powerup: You now deal increased damage for each heart that has taken ANY damage (So damaged half hearts or hearts with only 1 point of damage will still trigger this ability)
Difficulty Balancing
Tweaked difficulty scaling based on player power level and time spent in round 

Reduced level difficulties from 10 > 5 per level

Introduced new round lengths of 10/15/20 based on difficulty (Final boss is different with each increase in difficulty)

Distributed elites and bosses so they are more frequent at higher difficulties
Tutorial
Added explanation of “Resistance” enemies and how outlines determining resistances and vulnerabilities

Updated information on regenerating health

Added explanation of armor

Fixed a bug where the tutorial causes quests to spawn prematurely

Fixed a bug where tutorial causes issues with preload of enemies and impacts performance on the first run

Fixed a bug where the tutorial causes issues with enemies spawning in and dying without the player killing them on the first run

Set tutorial run to the 10 minutes so the player experiences an easier version of the run
Accessibility
Implemented auto aim
